visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and a grey turtleneck sweater holds a light blue smartphone in a portrait orientation. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman looking down at her phone with a distressed facial expression. The background has shifted to a blurred, greyish indoor auditorium with rows of empty seats. She is holding the phone with both hands, appearing to review a digital recording. (3) The woman is back in the studio setting with bright, even lighting. She holds a silver/light blue smartphone horizontally, showing the back of the device with its prominent five-lens camera system to the camera. (4) A close-up screen recording of a smartphone interface is shown. A finger with decorative nail art taps on a video editing tool. The UI shows sliders for Music, Human Voice, and Noise. The finger moves the Noise slider to a negative value. (5) The woman stands in an outdoor park setting with green trees and a metal railing. The camera captures her in a full shot, then cuts to close-ups of her fingernails which feature elaborate purple and white nail art with decorative stones. (6) A comparison view appears on screen, splitting the frame horizontally. The top half is labeled Galaxy S24 Ultra and the bottom half Galaxy S25 Ultra, showing the difference in clarity of a macro photograph. (7) An outdoor shot of a street lamp is shown. The camera zooms in smoothly from a wide shot to a tight close-up of the lamp's glass housing. (8) The woman returns to the studio, holding the phone and pointing at its camera lenses while smiling at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal, high-pitched female screaming and cheering, simulating a crowd at a concert. An upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM with a strong, four-on-the-floor beat plays simultaneously. The speaker's voice is not yet present, only the collective vocal noise. (2) There is a sudden acoustic shift as the screaming cuts out, replaced by a clear, moderate-volume female narration. Her tone is professional yet casual, speaking with high articulation clarity. The BGM ducks in volume to serve as a subtle background bed. (3) As the video demonstrates the 'Audio Eraser' feature, short, digital UI 'click' and 'tap' sound effects are heard, perfectly synced with the on-screen finger movements. The BGM remains consistent in tempo but feels less intrusive during the technical explanation. (4) During the outdoor segments, a very faint low-frequency ambient floor representing outdoor wind or distant traffic is audible, though the primary narration remains studio-clean and highly dominant. There are no noticeable distortions or technical artifacts. (5) The video concludes with the narrator increasing her pitch variability and speed slightly to convey excitement. A final 'ding' SFX with a high spectral centroid sounds as the brand logo is displayed, signaling the end of the informative segment.
